entries.title: Ione
entries.subtitle: Veyra's large natural moon
entries.summary: A large tidally locked moon of Veyra, with low gravity, negligible atmosphere and scientific installations.
entries.detail:
Ione is Veyra's major natural satellite. Low gravity and an extremely thin atmosphere give it an environment unlike the inhabited planetary surface, while its relatively quiet setting is useful for selected scientific observations.

Deep Three is a research station situated on Ione. This physical overview does not include the restricted history or experimental purpose of lunar research programs.
